items.title: The strict transform with respect to a composite blowing up is the iterated strict transform
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file divisors.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma says that for a blowing up which is exhibited as a composite of two blowing ups, the strict transform of a quasi-coherent module, and likewise of a closed subscheme, with respect to the composite equals the iterated strict transform with respect to the two steps (statement lines 8969-8989). The counted proof is a genuine sheaf-theoretic argument: it compares the two candidate transforms through two surjections from the pullback of the module, locates the supports of the relevant kernels on the preimages of the two centres, shows that the composed surjection factors through the strict transform with respect to the composite, and concludes by invoking the statement for two distinct centres to see that no nonzero sections are supported on the preimage of the union (proof lines 8991-9034). It is H2: the comparison and the support analysis are carried out in the counted span, with the cited input being the two-centres strict transform statement.
